verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents user deletion or suppression requests, or forwarding such requests to connected destinations. It shows only general privacy-compliance claims: a Privacy Portal that "helps streamline your response to new privacy regulations" and a suite of tools for GDPR/CCPA compliance. The rest is adjacent material, such as consent management and Public API CRUD on workspace resources like Sources and Destinations, which is not CRUD on end-user data.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
